## Invitations

A total of 2442 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 494 attended. The attendance rate was 20.2. These figures provide the overall position for invitations and attendance and indicate the level of participation recorded during the period. Attendance is reported against the number invited to support a clear comparison between outreach and participation.

The attendance figure is presented alongside the invitation total so that the reported rate can be understood in context. No further breakdown is included in this report.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 2111 invitees. Reminders went to 0. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, providing an additional means of contact where attendance did not take place.

The contact figures are recorded separately from attendance. They show the reported use of SMS, reminders, and telephone follow-up in support of the outreach activity.

Prepared by G. Evans.
